description: CSS cleanup and premium visual polish: remove ministry-strip styles, enhance hero section for stronger visual impact, improve overall landing page composition, and add premium styling touches for a modern EdTech feel.
steps: In frontend/src/styles/landing.css: Remove the entire .ministry-strip, .ministry-strip-inner, .ministry-strip-emblem, .ministry-strip-text styles block (approximately lines 558-587 equivalent - the section titled '── Ministry affiliation strip ──'). Also remove the ministry-strip responsive rule inside the @media (max-width: 480px) block.
In frontend/src/styles/responsive.css: Remove the .ministry-strip-inner rule inside @media (max-width: 480px) block. Remove the .ministry-strip reference inside @media print block.

In frontend/src/styles/landing.css: Enhance the hero section for more premium impact: (a) Increase hero padding from 'var(--sp-12) 0' to 'clamp(80px, 10vw, 140px) 0' for more breathing room. (b) Add a more dramatic gradient background glow to .landing-hero::before with richer color stops. (c) Make the landing-title more impactful: increase max clamp to 84px, add a subtle text-shadow for depth.

In frontend/src/styles/landing.css: Improve landing header feel without the ministry strip: (a) Add a subtle bottom border to .landing-header: 'border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border)' and slight glassmorphism backdrop: 'background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50'. This makes the header float elegantly now that the strip above is gone.

Add premium visual polish: (a) In the KPI strip section, add margin-top: var(--sp-6) to give more separation from hero. (b) Ensure the landing-brand-text span has proper styling: add CSS rules for .landing-brand-text with 'display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.2;', .landing-brand-name with 'font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: -0.01em;', and .landing-brand-sub with 'font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500;'. This ensures the new Madarek brand text in the header looks polished.

Final CSS pass: (a) Ensure all sections have proper spacing now that ministry strip is removed. (b) Add a subtle animated gradient border or glow to the hero image for premium feel: '.landing-hero-img::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 52, 97, 0.2), rgba(45, 219, 222, 0.15), rgba(0, 52, 97, 0.2)); z-index: -1; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.6s ease; }' and '.landing-hero-img:hover::after { opacity: 1; }'
